body:
## Problem

Inside a container that has the host Docker socket (a hive-mind root container), dss runs **real `docker diff` on its own container**, even with `--no-docker` and in unit tests. On 2026-10-09 running `npm test` there produced about 22 concurrent `docker diff` calls on that container. The host dockerd grew to **7.3 GB RSS** on an 11.7 GB host and the kernel OOM-killed it:

```
kernel: Out of memory: Killed process 823 (dockerd) total-vm:13940936kB, anon-rss:7302520kB … oom_score_adj:-500
dockerd (after restart): request cancelled by client … request-url=/v1.55/containers/4fc2a4947f94…/changes   ×22
```

systemd restarted dockerd, which killed **every container on the host** (the root container and four running AI tasks). Separately, `npm test` left fixture directories behind in `/tmp` (`/tmp/dss-emergency-*/projects/{old,recent}/node_modules`, 7 copies).

## Root cause

- [`scan()`](https://github.com/link-foundation/disk-space-saviour/blob/505941e8d1dd041c428f76a3f7b47c31a2f9eef5/src/scan.js#L344-L349) always calls `configureContainerHost(env, await selfContainerIds(env))`, whatever `--no-docker`/`docker: false` says. [`selfContainerIds`](https://github.com/link-foundation/disk-space-saviour/blob/505941e8d1dd041c428f76a3f7b47c31a2f9eef5/src/scan.js#L203) reads `/proc/self/cgroup` and `mountinfo` through `env.readText`.
- The test helper [`FixtureEnv extends LocalEnv`](https://github.com/link-foundation/disk-space-saviour/blob/505941e8d1dd041c428f76a3f7b47c31a2f9eef5/tests/helpers/fixtures.js#L99) does not override `readText`, so inside a container every fixture scan finds the real container ID. [`configureContainerHost`](https://github.com/link-foundation/disk-space-saviour/blob/505941e8d1dd041c428f76a3f7b47c31a2f9eef5/src/docker/writable.js#L106) then attaches a `WritableLayer` that runs the real `docker diff`.
- `node --test` runs test files in parallel, and each `scan()` creates its own `WritableLayer`, so nothing dedupes the diffs.
- [`tests/emergency.test.js`](https://github.com/link-foundation/disk-space-saviour/blob/505941e8d1dd041c428f76a3f7b47c31a2f9eef5/tests/emergency.test.js#L60) temp roots are not always removed.

## Reproduction

In any container started with `-v /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock` and a few GB in its writable layer: `npm ci && npm test`, then watch `docker ps`/dockerd memory on the host and `ps -ef | grep "docker diff"` in the container.

## Suggested fix

- Tests must be hermetic: `FixtureEnv` should answer `/proc/self/*` itself (no container), and a guard test should fail if any test spawns `docker`.
- Respect `--no-docker` / `docker: false` for writable-layer accounting too, or add a dedicated flag.
- Share one `WritableLayer` per container ID per process, and never run more than one `docker diff` at a time against a daemon.
- Before a `docker diff`, check host memory headroom and the container's change count; skip with `sizeUnknown` instead of risking the daemon.
- Remove every test temp root in `after`/`finally`.

---

We need to download all logs and data related about the issue to this repository, make sure we compile that data to `./docs/case-studies/issue-{id}` folder, and use it to do deep case study analysis (also make sure to search online for additional facts and data), in which we will reconstruct timeline/sequence of events, list of each and all requirements from the issue, find root causes of the each problem, and propose possible solutions and solution plans for each requirement (we should also check known existing components/libraries, that solve similar problem or can help in solutions).

If there is not enough data to find actual root cause, add debug output and verbose mode if not present, that will allow us to find root cause on next iteration.

If issue related to any other repository/project, where we can report issues on GitHub, please do so. Each issue must contain reproducible examples, workarounds and suggestions for fix the issue in code. Also double check to fully apply requirements to entire codebase, so if we have issue in multiple places, it should be fixed in all them.

Please plan and execute everything in this single pull request, you have unlimited time and context, as context auto-compacts and you can continue indefinitely, until it is each and every requirement fully addressed, and everything is totally done.
title: Tests and --no-docker still run real docker diff on the container dss runs in; 22 concurrent diffs OOM-killed the host dockerd and every container
